title: Profilometry Analyzer
description: Reproducible analysis of stylus profilometer line scans (Dektak-compatible CSV/TXT/xlsx exports): robust levelling with the steps masked, step height and film thickness with uncertainty (film edges, ISO 5436-1 type A1 evaluation of grooves and ridges, burr exclusion, periodic lines), ISO 21920-2 roughness parameters with the ISO 16610-21 Gaussian filter, Stoney film stress from curvature, batch tables per sample, a desktop application and a JSON project file that reproduces every number. Not affiliated with Bruker.
